messages:
Nora Kim: Quick prep thread for Tue's webinar 'Practical Inference at Scale'  need a compact ops list: slide timecodes, captions (EN + ES), caption burn-in for socials, recording retention policy, and Pardot routing. Who takes captions?
Ethan Brooks: I can own captions + VTT exports. Plan: enable Zoom live captions, export VTT, then run translate job to ES. Need slide timecodes from Priya to align.
Priya Reddy: On it  I'll add slide timestamps into speaker notes and export slide_timecodes.csv format: slide_number,start_timestamp,speaker. Will drop here in ~1.5h.
Maya Patel: Im doing social edits + reels. Requirements: deliver 9:16 for IG Reels, 1:1 for LinkedIn, include burn-in captions for socials, and supply a clip metadata CSV (speaker,timestamp,caption). Request production to mark good cut points.
Devon (events): Zoom config checklist: cloud recording enabled, separate audio, alternative host @Ethan, require registration, passcode on, disable join before host, host-only Q&A chat, disable file transfer. Also set live-stream fallback to internal RTMP for backup. Retention: set public replay retention 180 days (per marketing ask).
Nora Kim: Lead routing: push registrants to Pardot list 'webinar_practical_inference_may2026'. Tag lead_source=webinar, medium=email. High-intent rules: watch_pct >=75% OR clicked 'Book a demo' => assign to sales-ABM queue. Otherwise to nurture.
Ethan Brooks: Transcription flow: Zoom VTT -> ASR-cleaner -> produce canonical EN VTT + translated ES SRT. Fallback: if VTT not ready in 3h, run Whisper on the raw audio in S3. Also produce speaker-segment JSON for clipping job (speaker,start,end) — will post as CSV in thread.
Priya Reddy: Slide timecodes CSV will include slide title in the third column for easy clip labeling. Example row: 12,00:23:10,Nora Kim - 'Caching & KV'
Maya Patel: Clip creation API (internal): `/clip-create START END ASPECT BURNIN S3_DEST` eg: `/clip-create 00:10:30 00:11:00 9:16 true s3://webinars/may2026/clips/clip1.mp4` Please include `caption_source=vtt` tag if available.
Devon (events): Automation: processing webhook will post to #marketing with S3 links + manifest.json. Webhook endpoint: https://hooks.redwood-internal/webinars/process-2 (prod uses token). Also, webinar-bot will ping ops channel when clips ready for review.
Nora Kim: Follow-up cadence: immediate (within 24h) send replay + slides + transcript (EN toggle / ES link) + CTAs: 1) Book a demo, 2) Read benchmarks. 48h send top 60s clip. 7d resend full replay to non-openers. Track UTM: utm_campaign=practical_inference_may2026, utm_medium=email, utm_source=webinar_reg; variant suffixes: _replay_v1, _clip_v1, _nurture_v1.
Ethan Brooks: Minor gotcha: Zoom VTT sometimes missing speaker labels. Our ASR-cleaner will attempt diarization; still expect some manual QC. Please plan 1h QC slot after transcript is produced.
Maya Patel: Accessibility: deliver burned-in captions + separate SRTs for player. Also recommend adding captions button on landing replay page. I'll coordinate with web to support EN/ES toggle.
Priya Reddy: Dropping slide_timecodes.csv in 20m here. 
Devon (events): Confirmed owners: Captions/Transcripts=Ethan; Slide timecodes=Priya; Social clips=Maya; Zoom + recording orchestration=Devon; Post-event Pardot routing & follow-ups=Nora. I'll create checklist in the calendar event and assign tasks. :white_check_mark:
webinar-bot: Rehearsal reminder scheduled 2026-05-12 14:00 UTC  30m before send reminder to hosts.
